wins: Identified reachable perimeter hosts within the first 5 minutes, enabling focused follow-up scans.
Captured and documented full command sequence for initial reconnaissance, providing clear handoff for future operators.
fails: No successful privilege escalation or lateral movement achieved, resulting in 0% success rate despite repeated attempts.
Automated exploitation scripts timed out twice due to unhandled network latency, leaving initial foothold unstable.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was executed efficiently but stagnated at exploitation; need better resilience for post-recon phases.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploitation attempts failed when automated modules timed out on high-latency targets.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 open and HTTP response includes known CMS headers
skill_cards.then_action: Run gobuster enumeration followed by CMS-specific nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service is detected with banner indicating weak configuration
skill_cards.then_action: Perform targeted key scanning via ssh-audit and credential spraying

skill_cards.if_condition: When target responds slowly to exploit modules
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to low-bandwidth C2 payloads and increase timeouts before retrying exploit

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Critical for reliable exploitation against slow targets

next_experiments.title: Exploit latency-resistant foothold
next_experiments.description: Deploy non-TCP payloads with extended session timeouts and monitor for delayed callbacks before retrying module.

next_experiments.title: Credential spraying refinement
next_experiments.description: Integrate hydra with the successful username set from reconnaissance and adaptive backoff to reduce lockouts.
